name: get_deployment
description:
Get a deployment by its ID or hostname. When withGitRepoInfo is true, the response also includes Git source details. Additional details are included when the authenticated user or team owns the deployment.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel --scope {teamSlugOrId} inspect {deploymentIdOrUrl}. Fill placeholders from inputs.

idOrUrl.description: The unique identifier or hostname of the deployment.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

withGitRepoInfo.description: When `true`, the response includes the `gitSource` object with the commit SHA, branch name, and connected repository metadata. Defaults to `false`.
